thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered for ORION-APPS (reserved pool RDP-7) — high 5xx rate and queue saturation. Alert: tenant:orion-apps, metric:tail_latency_p95 > 2.1s, kv_cache_miss_rate > 60%. https://metrics.redwood/alerts/1715307890 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident #PD-67231 created and routed to eng-oncall. Escalation policy: reserved-pool.
lee_oncall: acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it. grabbing graphs.
maya_sre: thx. quick note — RDP-7 has been at 100% reserved utilization since 11:12 UTC and we've seen repeated OOMs on model-worker pods (evictions). Logs show kvcache eviction flood.
jamal_runtime: jumping in — what model variant? looks like a LlamaX-13B q4f. warm cache size for that model spiked and then degenerated.
lee_oncall: customer traffic spike? any deploys?
maya_sre: no deploys in last 2 hours. Traffic pattern shows many short-chat bursts from ORION-APPS around 11:10. Queue length > 500 (target < 100).
david_account: pinging account team — heads up to inform Orion; hold off external comms until we have impact.
lee_oncall: running quick mitigations: 1) enable burst capacity for RDP-7 (tmp) 2) scale dedicated queue workers 3) fallback routing to hosted small-variant. executing now.
lee_oncall: runbook steps I'm using: ```# Runbook excerpt
# 1) enable-burst --pool RDP-7 --tokens 200
# 2) scale-pool --pool RDP-7 --replicas +2
# 3) set-routing --tenant orion-apps --fallback hosted-llama-small
```
maya_sre: logs show repeated OOM from process: kvcache_manager. snippet:
```
[11:16:42] kvcache: miss_rate=0.72 cache_size=12MB/256MB evicted=23456
[11:16:43] worker: oom_kill signal pid=8243 mem=14.8Gi
```
jamal_runtime: I can push a config to lower per-request kvprefetch for orion-apps (reduce memory pressure). prepping patch.
lee_oncall: burst enabled. pool scaled +2. routing set to fallback hosted-llama-small (gradual). watching.
maya_sre: tail latency down to 1.4s p95, 5xx rate dropping but still noisy. kv_cache_miss down to 45% after fallback gradually taking load.
david_account: customer impact: partial degradation — some requests received 5xx and elevated latency for about ~12 minutes starting 11:10 UTC. I'll prepare a short status note for Orion if we stabilize.
lee_oncall: ack. need to escalate to runtime for a deeper root cause — marking P1 due to customer-SLA reserved pool impact. @jamal_runtime please take lead on long-term mitigation (kvcache tuning and pod memory).
jamal_runtime: on it. schedule: will revert fallback once stable and deploy kvprefetch patch in 15m. also will pin model to q4f-compact to reduce worker memory.
eve_oncall_next: (next oncall) I'll be on deck in 20m for handoff. please leave summary.
lee_oncall: handoff summary for @eve_oncall_next: ORION-APPS triggered high 5xx/latency due to kvcache miss + OOMs in RDP-7. Actions done: burst enabled, pool +2 replicas, fallback routing to hosted-llama-small, kvprefetch patch queued, model pin planned. Current status: p95 ~1.2s, 5xx trending to baseline but not fully back. Next steps: monitor 30m, verify OOMs stop, roll kvpatch, coordinate account update.
maya_sre: created follow-up ticket INF-4802 for postmortem / capacity tuning. linking logs and allocations.
david_account: I'll draft the customer note and hold until we confirm all OOMs cleared.
jamal_runtime: deploying kvprefetch patch now: `kubectl apply -f /patches/orion-kvprefetch.yaml` — ETA 6m.
lee_oncall: handing off to @eve_oncall_next at 11:34 UTC. I will stay available for questions.
eve_oncall_next: thanks. I'll take watch. if we see another spike re-escalate to oncall lead. closing oncall ack. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Pager resolved for ORION-APPS (alert state cleared) at 11:43 UTC.
lee_oncall: marking incident as mitigated; will wait for postmortem ticket updates.
david_account: preparing customer note: "We experienced a short service degradation affecting your dedicated pool RDP-7 between 11:10-11:22 UTC. Mitigations applied; our engineering team will follow up with root cause and corrective actions."
maya_sre: postmortem checklist started. will include KV cache retention tuning, autoscale thresholds, and runbook clarifications.
lee_oncall: closing thread unless new alerts pop. good work team. :v:
